description: Canonical concept inventory for physical-dynamics curriculum scenarios.
notes: This inventory maps raw expected_process and contrast_process strings onto stable concept ids.
Use canonical_concepts for balance analysis; use surface_to_concept to normalize scenario labels.

Direction-neutral landmark verbs such as crossed, passed, and went by should not be mapped by verb alone. They are resolved through expected_process values such as upward crossing and downward crossing.
Some contrast-only labels are mapped to absence or counterfactual concepts so contrast distributions can also be inspected.

canonical_concepts.label: fall or drop downward
canonical_concepts.description: Downward motion caused by gravity, release, or support loss.

canonical_concepts.label: rise upward
canonical_concepts.description: Upward motion caused by buoyancy, lift, warm air, wind, or similar force.

canonical_concepts.label: lift upward
canonical_concepts.description: Controlled upward motion caused by an external support, motor, rope, hand, or tool.

canonical_concepts.label: sink downward
canonical_concepts.description: Downward motion through a medium, usually because density or weight overcomes buoyancy.

canonical_concepts.label: float at or upward to a surface
canonical_concepts.description: Remaining at a surface or moving upward to it because buoyancy or trapped air supports the object.

canonical_concepts.label: cross a landmark upward
canonical_concepts.description: An entity changes from below a landmark to above it.

canonical_concepts.label: cross a landmark downward
canonical_concepts.description: An entity changes from above a landmark to below it.

canonical_concepts.label: roll
canonical_concepts.description: Translation with rotation.

canonical_concepts.label: slide
canonical_concepts.description: Translation without rotation or with rotation blocked.

canonical_concepts.label: tip
canonical_concepts.description: Rotate away from level or upright support.

canonical_concepts.label: topple
canonical_concepts.description: Lose upright balance and fall over.

canonical_concepts.label: collapse
canonical_concepts.description: Fold, cave in, or fail structurally after support is removed.

canonical_concepts.label: remain stable
canonical_concepts.description: Remain level, balanced, upright, or otherwise supported.

canonical_concepts.label: remain in place
canonical_concepts.description: Stay in place, stay held, or otherwise not move as the target process would.

canonical_concepts.label: speed up
canonical_concepts.description: Increase speed because of a push, pull, spring, fan, or similar force.

canonical_concepts.label: slow down
canonical_concepts.description: Decrease speed because of friction, uphill motion, resistance, or opposing force.

canonical_concepts.label: stop
canonical_concepts.description: Motion ends because of resistance, contact, or an opposing force.

canonical_concepts.label: continue moving
canonical_concepts.description: Continue moving or sliding instead of stopping.

canonical_concepts.label: compress
canonical_concepts.description: Become squeezed, shortened, or flattened under pressure.

canonical_concepts.label: stretch
canonical_concepts.description: Become longer or taut under pulling force.

canonical_concepts.label: grow larger
canonical_concepts.description: Become larger over time because material, air, water, heat, or growth increases size.

canonical_concepts.label: shrink smaller
canonical_concepts.description: Become smaller over time because material, air, water, heat, or tension is removed or reduced.

canonical_concepts.label: maintain shape
canonical_concepts.description: Keep shape rather than compressing or deforming.

canonical_concepts.label: remain slack
canonical_concepts.description: Stay slack rather than stretching.

canonical_concepts.label: rebound or bounce away
canonical_concepts.description: Move back or away after contact.

canonical_concepts.label: stick
canonical_concepts.description: Remain attached or caught after contact.

canonical_concepts.label: scatter
canonical_concepts.description: Pieces or objects spread apart after contact.

canonical_concepts.label: remain together
canonical_concepts.description: Objects stay together instead of scattering.

canonical_concepts.label: crack or break
canonical_concepts.description: A hard object breaks, cracks, or loses integrity.

canonical_concepts.label: dent
canonical_concepts.description: A surface deforms inward after impact.

canonical_concepts.label: remain intact
canonical_concepts.description: Stay whole rather than cracking or breaking.

canonical_concepts.label: spill
canonical_concepts.description: Material leaves a container after tipping, opening, or loss of containment.

canonical_concepts.label: remain contained
canonical_concepts.description: Material stays inside or below a boundary.

canonical_concepts.label: leak
canonical_concepts.description: Material escapes slowly through a crack, hole, or unsealed part.

canonical_concepts.label: drain
canonical_concepts.description: Liquid flows out or downward through an opening.

canonical_concepts.label: remain pooled
canonical_concepts.description: Liquid stays pooled rather than draining.

canonical_concepts.label: absorb or soak up
canonical_concepts.description: A porous object takes liquid into itself.

canonical_concepts.label: not absorb
canonical_concepts.description: Liquid is left behind rather than being absorbed.

canonical_concepts.label: overflow
canonical_concepts.description: Material rises above a rim or boundary and escapes.

canonical_concepts.label: flow downward
canonical_concepts.description: Liquid follows a guided downward path.

canonical_concepts.label: spread sideways
canonical_concepts.description: Liquid spreads laterally rather than following the intended downward path.
